responsibility: Exercises the utility formatting helper in `common.rs` by verifying that `to_readable_str` renders `usize` values with underscore-separated thousands groups.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the crate-root `tests.rs`, which only forces test-binary linkage, and `mir/interpret/allocation/tests.rs`, which covers interpreter allocation state, this `tests.rs` is the utility-module test file focused on the general-purpose `to_readable_str` formatter.
